tools.name: search_maimai_songs
tools.description: Search local maimai DX song data by song ID, fuzzy title, chart level, chart constant, difficulty, or chart type. Fuzzy title search also checks local aliases. Returns every matching song and the matching charts for each song. When LXNS/CN and dxrating/JP both have the same title, fields are merged under source_fields.cn and source_fields.jp.

query.description: Song ID like 11451/id11451, a fuzzy song title, or an alias fragment.

level.description: Chart level, for example 13, 13+, 14+. Trailing ? in data is ignored.

genre.description: Song genre/category filter. Fuzzy substring match, for example POPS or niconico.

version.description: Song/chart version filter. Fuzzy substring match, for example PRiSM PLUS or dx-prism-plus.

ds.description: Chart constant. Supports a number, or a string range such as 13.4-13.8.

ds_min.description: Minimum chart constant. Overrides ds range lower bound when supplied.

ds_max.description: Maximum chart constant. Overrides ds range upper bound when supplied.

fit_diff.description: Fitted chart constant. Single values are bucketed by one decimal, e.g. 13.1 means [13.10, 13.20). String ranges such as 13.13-13.27 are exact ranges.

fit_diff_min.description: Minimum fitted chart constant. Range bounds are not bucketed.

fit_diff_max.description: Maximum fitted chart constant. Range bounds are not bucketed.

fit_delta.description: Actual ds minus fitted constant. Supports exact value or string range.

fit_label.description: Filter by 虚高 or 虚低. 虚高 means ds - fit_diff > 0; 虚低 means ds - fit_diff < 0.

region_has.description: Require song availability in one or more regions: jp/intl/usa/cn or 日服/国际服/美服/国服.

region_missing.description: Require song not to be available in one or more regions: jp/intl/usa/cn or 日服/国际服/美服/国服.

sort.description: Optional fit sorting. fit_delta_desc finds most 虚高; fit_delta_asc finds most 虚低.

difficulty.description: Difficulty such as Basic/Advanced/Expert/Master/Re:MASTER or 绿/黄/红/紫/白.

song_type.description: Chart type: standard/SD, dx, or utage/宴.

is_new.description: Filter by new song status. true returns only new songs, false returns only non-new songs.

is_new_source.description: Which server to check for is_new: 'cn' for national server, 'jp' for international server. If omitted, checks all sources.

id.description: Song ID match. Supports a single integer, or a string range like '100-500'.

id_min.description: Optional minimum song ID (inclusive). Overrides id range lower bound.

id_max.description: Optional maximum song ID (inclusive). Overrides id range upper bound.

bpm.description: BPM filter. Supports a single number, or a string range like '160-180'.

bpm_min.description: Optional minimum BPM (inclusive). Overrides bpm range lower bound.

bpm_max.description: Optional maximum BPM (inclusive). Overrides bpm range upper bound.

is_locked.description: Filter by dxdata's isLocked field. true returns only locked songs (need to be unlocked in-game); false returns only unlocked songs.

artist.description: Song artist filter. Case-insensitive substring match across all sources, e.g. 'sasakure' or 'かめりあ'.

charter.description: Chart designer (谱师) filter. Case-insensitive substring match against per-chart note designer, e.g. 'jun' or 'safari'. Narrows matched_charts.

tag.description: Required dxrating tag(s) (mirrors dxrating.net /search → 配置/难度/评价). Accepts tag ID, zh-Hans/en/ja/ko name, comma- or slash-separated for multi-tag (e.g. '爆发,纵连' or 'Jacks/Burst'). Matched per chart with every() semantics: each chart must carry ALL listed tags.

tag_exclude.description: Forbidden tag(s). Charts carrying any listed tag are dropped. Same input format as tag.

released_after.description: Earliest chart release date (inclusive). Accepts YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Per-chart match against dxdata releaseDate.

released_before.description: Latest chart release date (inclusive). Accepts YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: Optional maximum result count. Omit to return all matches.

format.description: Tool result format. Defaults to text (full verbose: every source × every chart). Use compact for list view (grouped by ST/DX chart type, deduplicated across sources, no fit_label noise) — good for limit>=5 searches. Use json only for debugging or full raw fields.

include_raw.description: Return the full raw JSON payload instead of the readable text summary.

debug.description: Alias for include_raw; returns raw JSON for troubleshooting.

tools.name: refresh_maimai_sources
tools.description: Manually refresh local maimai data sources. By default it refreshes only sources older than the 3-day TTL; pass force=true to refresh regardless of age. Due sources are refreshed concurrently; failed sources are reported individually. Pass background=true to run refresh in a background thread (like group ranking refresh) to avoid MCP timeout when refreshing many sources or large ones like dxdata.

sources.description: Source or sources to refresh: all, lxns, dxdata, yuzu, divingfish, chart_stats, dxrating_aliases, dxrating_tags, plate. Defaults to all.

source.description: Alias of sources for a single source name.

force.description: Refresh even when source files are newer than ttl_days. When true, automatically uses background mode.

ttl_days.description: Source freshness TTL in days. Defaults to 0.0208 (30 minutes).

check_only.description: Only report source age and whether refresh is due; do not download.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-source command timeout. Sources refresh concurrently.

background.description: Run refresh in background thread and return immediately. Use for large or force refreshes to avoid MCP timeout.

format.description: Tool result format. Defaults to text (full verbose: every source × every chart). Use compact for list view (grouped by ST/DX chart type, deduplicated across sources, no fit_label noise) — good for limit>=5 searches. Use json only for debugging or full raw fields.

include_raw.description: Return the full raw JSON payload instead of the readable text summary.

debug.description: Alias for include_raw; returns raw JSON for troubleshooting.

tools.name: find_score_combinations
tools.description: Search whether a chart can achieve an exact score or score range under judgment restrictions. Returns multiple matching judgment-count combinations up to max_solutions. Supports allowed/disallowed judgment groups and fixed/min/max counts per note type. score_mode=oldscore searches old-frame/FiNALE raw score. score_mode=dxscore searches DX SCORE. score_mode=oldacc or dxacc searches displayed percentage units; target_score=1004999 means 100.4999 when display_digits=4, and percentage strings such as 100.4999% are also accepted. If note_totals is omitted, query/song_id/title can be supplied; the server searches the local song cache, calculates only when exactly one song and one chart match, and otherwise returns candidate songs/charts without score calculation.

note_totals.description: Chart note totals, e.g. {"tap": 100, "touch": 12, "hold": 20, "slide": 30, "break": 5}. Touch has the same value as Tap; touch_hold aliases are normalized to hold.

target_score.description: Exact selected-mode score. For oldscore/dxscore/base/break_bonus use a raw integer. For oldacc/dxacc, an integer is scaled percentage without the decimal point, e.g. 1004999 means 100.4999 when display_digits=4; strings like 100.4999 or 100.4999% are accepted.

target_acc.description: Optional oldacc/dxacc target percentage such as 100.4999 or 100.4999%. Equivalent to target_score as a percentage string.

min_score.description: Minimum selected-mode score. In oldacc/dxacc, follows the same scaled-integer or percentage-string rules as target_score.

max_score.description: Maximum selected-mode score. In oldacc/dxacc, follows the same scaled-integer or percentage-string rules as target_score.

min_acc.description: Optional oldacc/dxacc minimum percentage such as 100.4000%.

max_acc.description: Optional oldacc/dxacc maximum percentage such as 100.5000%.

score_mode.description: Search in base, break_bonus, oldscore raw score, oldacc percentage, dxscore, or dxacc percentage. For oldacc/dxacc, target_score can be a scaled display integer or a percentage string.

allowed_judgments.description: Optional note type -> allowed judgments/groups. Groups include all, not_miss, no_miss, great, perfect, perfect_or_critical, ap, fc_plus, fc.

disallowed_judgments.description: Optional note type -> forbidden judgments/groups, applied after allowed_judgments.

fixed_counts.description: Exact counts to force: note type -> judgment -> count.

min_counts.description: Minimum counts to force: note type -> judgment -> count.

max_counts.description: Maximum counts to enforce: note type -> judgment -> count.

no_miss_good.description: Shortcut restriction: all note types disallow miss and good.

fc_plus_only.description: Alias of no_miss_good; allows only great/perfect/critical judgments.

break_max_perfect_or_below.description: Shortcut restriction: Break notes with judgment below Critical may be at most this many.

max_solutions.description: Maximum matching combinations to return. Use 0 for count-only reachability checks. If more combinations exist than returned, the response sets truncated=true while keeping matching_combination_count exact.

max_states.description: Search-state cap to avoid runaway combinatorics.

display_mode.description: Only for score_mode=oldacc or dxacc. Interprets target_score as floor display, half-up display, or exact raw percentage.

display_digits.description: Only for score_mode=oldacc or dxacc. Number of displayed decimal digits; default 4.

query.description: Optional song ID, old DX ID, fuzzy title, or alias. When note_totals is omitted, the server resolves this to one chart and uses its note totals.

song_id.description: Optional explicit song ID, used like query when note_totals is omitted.

title.description: Optional exact/fuzzy title, used like query when note_totals is omitted.

level.description: Optional chart level filter for direct song lookup, for example 13+.

genre.description: Optional genre/category filter for direct song lookup.

version.description: Optional song/chart version filter for direct song lookup.

ds.description: Optional chart constant or range for direct song lookup.

ds_min.description: Optional minimum chart constant for direct song lookup.

ds_max.description: Optional maximum chart constant for direct song lookup.

fit_diff.description: Optional fitted chart constant filter for direct song lookup.

fit_diff_min.description: Optional minimum fitted chart constant for direct song lookup.

fit_diff_max.description: Optional maximum fitted chart constant for direct song lookup.

fit_delta.description: Optional ds - fit_diff filter for direct song lookup.

fit_delta_min.description: Optional minimum ds - fit_diff for direct song lookup.

fit_delta_max.description: Optional maximum ds - fit_diff for direct song lookup.

fit_label.description: Optional 虚高 or 虚低 filter for direct song lookup.

region_has.description: Optional required region availability for direct song lookup.

region_missing.description: Optional required missing region availability for direct song lookup.

difficulty.description: Optional difficulty filter for direct song lookup.

song_type.description: Optional chart type filter for direct song lookup: standard/SD, dx, or utage/宴.

artist.description: Optional artist substring filter for direct song lookup.

charter.description: Optional chart designer (谱师) substring filter for direct song lookup.

format.description: Tool result format. Defaults to text (full verbose: every source × every chart). Use compact for list view (grouped by ST/DX chart type, deduplicated across sources, no fit_label noise) — good for limit>=5 searches. Use json only for debugging or full raw fields.

include_raw.description: Return the full raw JSON payload instead of the readable text summary.

debug.description: Alias for include_raw; returns raw JSON for troubleshooting.
